description: Four-piece ceramic brake pad set with a light cream friction compound moulded in a raised hexagonal honeycomb pattern, on steel backing plates. Shown with a small hardware packet and a Duralast Elite box marked 3X Longer Life.
Four-piece brake pad set with a deeply curved kidney-shaped profile, dark grey friction material and square mounting tabs at both ends. Pictured with a Duralast Gold retail box.

Four-piece brake pad set with grey friction material, mounting ears and attached wear-sensor clips with wire loops on two of the pads. Shown with a Duralast Gold box listing a semi-metallic OE-grade formulation, slots and chamfers, and low dust.

Set of four front brake pads with a rounded upper edge and a single slot across the friction face. Shown loose without packaging, with grey friction material on one side and a matte black coated backing plate on the other. No brand markings visible.
Brake pad set with light cream ceramic friction material and steel backing plates carrying two round punched holes each. Pictured with a red and blue Duralast box marked as containing one set.

Set of four front brake pads with a squared profile and pronounced side mounting ears, supplied loose without packaging. Two pads show grey friction material and two show a glossy black backing plate. No brand markings visible.
Black spin-on oil filter canister with a white label reading BOSCH Premium Oil Filter and the part number 3978. Sealed steel can with a rolled base seam and a threaded centre mounting plate.

Cartridge-style oil filter element with tan pleated media and a black plastic end cap with lift tabs, supplied with a separate sealing ring. Shown beside an STP box marked S45011 and a 5,000 mile change interval. No metal canister - the element fits into a housing.
Blue spin-on oil filter canister shown with its STP retail box marked S45023 and a 5,000 mile change interval. Steel can with a threaded base plate and rubber sealing gasket.
Rectangular panel air filter with a moulded black rubber frame and yellow pleated paper media. The frame carries moulded FLOW direction arrows and a TOP orientation marking.

Cone-shaped performance air filter with red oiled cotton-gauze media, a polished chrome end cap, a black rubber mounting flange and a stainless hose clamp. Clamp-on type for cold-air or short-ram intakes.
Circular air filter with a black rubber sealing frame and gold-tan paper media pleated radially around a central mounting hole.
Oval performance air filter with red cotton-gauze media pleated radially around a centre hub, set in a black rubber frame embossed Premium Performance Filter.

Flat rectangular cabin air filter with a plastic frame and pleated media alternating white filtration layers with grey activated-carbon layers. This is a cabin filter rather than an engine intake filter.

Slim fuel injector with a stainless body, a black two-prong electrical connector, a green sealing O-ring at the fuel rail end and a blue O-ring above the spray tip. Single small spray orifice at the nozzle.
Compact stainless fuel injector with a hex-flanged high-pressure fuel inlet fitting at one end, an angled black electrical connector, a black sealing O-ring and a multi-hole spray tip.
Diesel injector with an elongated machined steel body, a hex fuel inlet fitting on top, an angled side-mounted high-pressure port, a black two-prong connector and a multi-hole nozzle tip.

Unit injector combining pump and nozzle in one assembly. Features a large exposed coil spring and plunger at the top, a cast mounting flange, a side-mounted black electrical connector and a long tapered nozzle body.

Injector rail assembly with four black-capped injectors mounted along a common brushed steel rail with two mounting ears. Each injector has its own electrical connector, and the rail has a fitting at each end.

Hydraulic power steering pump with a black plastic fluid reservoir and filler cap mounted on top of a cast-aluminium pump housing. A spoked metal pulley is fitted to the drive end, with a threaded pressure outlet and a hose barb on the side.

Compact hydraulic power steering pump shown from the drive end with the bare splined input shaft exposed and no pulley fitted. Cast-aluminium body with a machined mounting flange, four bolt bosses and a small fitting on one side.

Power steering pump combining a cast-aluminium hydraulic section with a large black cylindrical electric motor. Three brass port fittings on the pump body and a black multi-pin electrical connector on the motor housing.
Drive-by-wire throttle body with a cast-aluminium housing, a brass-tone butterfly plate visible through the bore, an integrated black actuator motor on one side and a multi-pin electrical connector.
Mechanical throttle body with a cast-aluminium housing, a brass-tone butterfly plate, an external cable pulley with a coil return spring and a linkage arm. No electronic actuator fitted.
Machined billet-aluminium throttle body with two separate bores, each holding a brass-tone butterfly plate on a shared shaft, a side cable linkage and a four-bolt mounting flange.

product_name: Throttle Body with Idle Air Control
description: Throttle body with a cast-aluminium housing, a brass-tone butterfly plate, an integrated black actuator motor, a multi-pin connector and two brass barbed vacuum ports on the lower housing.
Heavy-duty throttle valve with a rough cast housing, a wide intake bore with a plain metal butterfly plate, an oversized black electronic actuator and two brass port fittings.

product_name: Wheel Hub Assembly with ABS Sensor
description: Wheel hub assembly with a machined steel flange, protruding wheel studs and a splined centre bore. A black ABS sensor cable runs from the hub body to a moulded multi-pin connector.
Wheel hub assembly with a plain machined steel flange carrying five wheel studs and a smooth raised centre cap. No sensor cable fitted.
Compact wheel hub assembly shown at an angle, with four threaded wheel studs on a machined flange, a splined centre bore and a rough cast bearing housing behind with bolt holes.
Wheel hub assembly with a machined steel flange, protruding wheel studs around a raised centre cap, and a larger-diameter body than a compact passenger car hub.
Bare cast iron exhaust manifold with a rough dark grey as-cast finish, four siamesed runners feeding a single central outlet, and machined flange faces with six mounting holes.
Short tubular header with polished stainless runners welded to a thick black four-port flange plate. The runners curve tightly into a compact collector with a bolted outlet flange.
Brushed stainless manifold with three tubular runners merging into a barrel-shaped catalytic converter, with a bolted inlet flange, welded mounting brackets and an outlet flange.
Polished stainless long-tube header with four equal-length large-diameter runners sweeping into a single open collector pipe. Weld seams show heat colouring at each joint.
Manifold and catalytic converter assembly with a dull weathered steel finish. The converter body carries stamped identification text, with a threaded oxygen sensor bung ahead of the outlet flange.

Manifold and catalytic converter assembly viewed from the flange side, showing four dark exhaust ports in a cast flange. Stainless runners merge upward into the converter body, with a side outlet pipe and welded brackets.

Turbocharger mounted directly to a four-port cast exhaust manifold. The assembly includes the turbine housing, a compressor housing with machined outlet, and an electronic wastegate actuator with its wiring connector.

Compact stainless manifold with three runners merging into a cylindrical catalytic converter. A flat triangular mounting flange sits at the inlet, with a threaded oxygen sensor bung ahead of the outlet.
Pair of complete strut assemblies, each with a black coil spring, a yellow spring seat, a silver upper mounting plate with hub, and a black damper body with a welded lower bracket.
Pair of coilover shocks with red powder-coated coil springs over polished chrome damper bodies, a yellow threaded adjuster ring and eyelet mounts with pressed bushings at both ends.
Single coilover shock with a black coil spring over a polished chrome body, an angled upper eyelet and a straight lower eyelet, both fitted with bronze-bushed mounting eyes.
Front strut assembly with a dark coil spring over a cast aluminium strut housing. The lower housing forms an integral steering knuckle bracket with multiple bolt holes and a brake line fork.
Coilover shock with a silver coil spring, threaded body adjuster collars and a piggyback remote reservoir clamped alongside. Machined aluminium lower mount with an eyelet.
Bare front strut supplied without a spring - a black damper body with an upper spring seat, protruding piston rod, welded lower mounting bracket and a brake hose clip.
Air suspension strut with a double-convoluted black rubber air bellows over a polished body, an air line fitting at the top and a forged U-shaped lower mounting bracket.
Pair of plain twin-tube shock absorbers with matte black bodies, dust sleeves, and eyelet mounts at both ends fitted with bronze-coloured bushings. Supplied without springs.
Cylindrical control arm bushing viewed end-on, with black rubber bonded between a steel outer shell and a steel inner sleeve. Moulded voids on opposite sides tune the bushing's compliance.
Suspension bushing viewed end-on, with grey rubber bonded inside a polished steel outer ring. The steel inner sleeve has a finely splined end face.
Polyurethane bushing viewed end-on, showing translucent amber and orange urethane rings between a steel outer shell and a steel inner sleeve.
Matched left and right control arm bushings, each pressed into a cast metal mounting bracket with an elongated bolt slot. The black rubber centres have moulded relief voids around a hex inner sleeve.
Set of three green polyurethane bushings, each a short barrel of solid urethane around a steel inner sleeve, with a slightly waisted outer profile.
Single moulded rubber suspension bushing with an hourglass body and flared ends, showing a metal inner sleeve at the centre bore. A press-in rubber component with no outer shell.
Bushing pressed into a flat black mounting bracket with a bolt hole at each end. The barrel-shaped rubber body sits between the two arms of the bracket.
Kit of three white polyurethane bushings in graduated sizes, each with a top-hat profile - a flanged base with a raised body and a central bore.
